about: Tutorial cards for 'The Scar' and 'True Ground', in W1's shape: one at a time, 8 s, glass, top-left under the field note. HEAD in Chakra Petch caps, body in Plex Mono. Every card is kept in the Field Manual (Extras).

cards.head: HERD
cards.body: a Tiller's hull blocks a Plumb's sight. Walk in its lee and the herd walks you in.

cards.head: WALL
cards.body: a Screed cannot turn once it charges. Stand before a wall, step aside, and it stalls 3 s.

cards.head: RE-SURVEY
cards.body: on the benchmark, raise the Alidade ({key:alidade}) and hold it on a mark for 15 s. {key:bearing} takes each of three bearings.

cards.head: TRUE GROUND
cards.body: a re-surveyed region keeps its walls. Screeds stop choosing it, and the line comes off.
